luau.name: Luau
luau.reason: Luau's VM has two messages that no other Lua has, the bytecode loader's version check (VM/src/lvmload.cpp) and the readonly-table error (VM/src/ldebug.cpp). They are read in the module beside a WebAssembly loader, or in the script of a single-file build, where Emscripten writes the module's bytes as text. Both were found on 4 Nov 2026 in @luau-rs/luau 0.739.0 and luau-web 1.5.1, and neither in wasmoon 1.16.0 or love.js 11.4.1. A .luau file name identifies nothing. A single-file build that inlines its module as base64 is not recognised. Gate H has not been measured.

emscripten.name: Emscripten
emscripten.reason: Structural: Emscripten's runtime glue for a program with a main (its abort message, its build hint or fetch failure, and the noInitialRun test that decides whether main runs, all of which every optimisation level and Closure keep), beside a .wasm whose imports come only from Emscripten's modules: env and wasi_snapshot_preview1 by name up to -O2, or the one minified module `a` that -O3 and Closure write. Threads play no part, so a single-threaded build is named too. A library built with Emscripten and no main, such as a Draco or Basis decoder, is not the game and is not named. A MINIMAL_RUNTIME build writes none of that glue, and at -O2 its module imports are minified to `a.a`; its src/postamble_minimal.js instantiates Module.wasm, or a fetch of the module, with its own `imports` object and hands the exports to initRuntime, the same in 2.0.34, 3.1.0, 3.1.50 and 4.0.12, which the fourth signature reads (upstream source, not an exported game). A Closure-minified MINIMAL_RUNTIME build renames initRuntime and is not recognised. Gate H has not been measured.

patterns: Build with -s ?ASSERTIONS|both async and sync fetching of the wasm failed
signatures.evidence: Emscripten's runtime glue beside a module importing only from env and wasi_snapshot_preview1
signatures.source: Emscripten 6.0.13 (emcc e13ee988ce3d87a738dd8f3661d02223308c412a), 5 Nov 2026: one 12-line C program with a main loop, built at -O0, -O1, -O2, -O3 -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1, -O3 -g2, -O3 -sMODULARIZE, -O3 -sMODULARIZE -sEXPORT_ES6, -Os --closure 1, and -pthread at -O0 and -O3. Cross-checked against older shipped Emscripten glue on this machine (draco3d 1.5.7, basis_transcoder, MediaPipe tasks-vision, sharp-wasm32 0.35, watlas 1.0.1, pdf.js quickjs-eval), each of which carries the first two patterns and, having no main, not the third (watlas, an ASSERTIONS build, names noInitialRun only in its list of ignored settings, which the pattern does not read). The -O0 to -O2 modules import from env and wasi_snapshot_preview1 by name; sha256 is the -O2 index.js.

patterns: Build with -s ?ASSERTIONS|both async and sync fetching of the wasm failed
signatures.evidence: Emscripten's runtime glue beside a module with Emscripten's minified imports
signatures.source: Emscripten 6.0.13 (emcc e13ee988ce3d87a738dd8f3661d02223308c412a), 5 Nov 2026: one 12-line C program with a main loop, built at -O0, -O1, -O2, -O3 -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1, -O3 -g2, -O3 -sMODULARIZE, -O3 -sMODULARIZE -sEXPORT_ES6, -Os --closure 1, and -pthread at -O0 and -O3. Cross-checked against older shipped Emscripten glue on this machine (draco3d 1.5.7, basis_transcoder, MediaPipe tasks-vision, sharp-wasm32 0.35, watlas 1.0.1, pdf.js quickjs-eval), each of which carries the first two patterns and, having no main, not the third (watlas, an ASSERTIONS build, names noInitialRun only in its list of ignored settings, which the pattern does not read). The -O3, -O3 -g2 and Closure modules import everything from one module named a, with minified names; sha256 is the -O3 index.js.

webassembly.name: WebAssembly
webassembly.reason: Reported when a page script instantiates a .wasm module that the bundle carries and names, and no other engine is recognised. engines.ts rawWebAssembly decides it in code, after every other probe, so it is never reported beside another engine. A bundle whose glue names Emscripten, wasm-bindgen, Go, Unity, Godot, Defold or Kaigen, or whose .wasm module has their imports, Kaigen's section or a licence stamp, stays custom. The glue of a library built with Emscripten, a Draco or Ammo.js beside the game, is set aside rather than counted either way. A plain JavaScript game that loads one helper module of its own is also named WebAssembly. Gate H has not been measured.
